summary: Kimi Antonelli surged from 19th on the grid to win the Italian Grand Prix, becoming the first Italian to win at Monza since 1966 and delivering a recovery drive through an incident-packed race. The Mercedes driver's masterclass in wet-weather management and overtaking prompted comparisons to the sport's greatest comebacks, with his performance leaving team-mate George Russell's championship bid in serious jeopardy. Antonelli's Monza victory tightens the title battle significantly, elevating the 22-year-old into contention while Russell's deficit grows.
